M-LABEL-WIDGET.Purpose: Read-only text display with intrinsic measurement, wrapping, ellipsis and tooltips.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Label Content, Font, TextAlign, TextTransform, TextWrap, TextOverflow and Color.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Text measurement, overflow behavior and automatic or explicit Tooltip.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Text editing, caret and IME — owned by M-TEXT-FIELD-WIDGET.

Requirements.REQ-001: Intrinsic text measurement reflects font, transformed content and wrap; Flexbox owns external box constraints and edges.
Requirements.REQ-002: Explicit newlines survive TextWrap settings; TextOverflow Ellipsis shortens unwrapped text and falls back to Clip for wrapped text.
Requirements.REQ-003: Label draws only text within its content rectangle; general decorative surfaces are composed through View.
Requirements.REQ-004: AutoTooltip and explicit Tooltip remain distinct presentation controls.

Inputs.IN-001: Content string, typography, layout and tooltip Props.

Outputs.OUT-001: Measured content Size and read-only native drawn text.
